messages:
zoe: Heads-up: prepping internal announce for v2.19.0 tomorrow. Canary 08:30 UTC, quiet window 08:15-10:00 UTC. Draft here: https://docs.redwood/releases/v2.19.0-draft. Please flag customer-facing items.

deploybot: /deploy canary v2.19.0 --targets=canary-10 --timeout=20m
deploybot: Canary started: v2.19.0 -> canary-10 (10 hosts). Monitoring p95, p99, 5xx, memory.

omar: We changed KMS integration wording; legal needs to sign off on the customer-facing sentence. They asked for exact phrasing.

legal: quick note: we can approve if line reads: "Optional customer-managed keys (KMS) are available; not enabled by default." We need 12h to fully review telemetry language.

suki: Ops note: Dedicated fleets will be pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-04-01 during GA. Add unpin timeline: ~10 business days post-GA.

ops-oncall: Rollback thresholds proposal: auto-rollback if 5xx >= 0.16% sustained 5m OR p99 latency +35% for 10m. Manual rollback requires release owner + oncall sign-off. I'll be oncall 08:00-10:30 UTC (PD_Rollout).

deploybot: Canary update @10m: p95 +5%, p99 +9%, 5xx 0.03%. No auto-rollback.

zoe: OK. Plan: post internal announce at 08:05 UTC with a note that public announce is "pending legal" until the telemetry wording is finalized. Include runbook: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/v2.19-rollout and support copy.

omar: I'll paste the approved KMS line into the draft once legal confirms.

legal: approved KMS line above. Telemetry wording cleared for customer-facing docs.

suki: Adding suggested support one-liners: "Why runtime pinned?" -> "Pinned during GA to reduce variability; unpin schedule will be communicated."

zoe: Final internal announce copy: "Internal: staged rollout v2.19.0. Canary healthy; promoting to staged rollout. Quiet window 08:15-10:00 UTC. Key items: Dedicated runtime pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-04-01; optional KMS available (disabled by default); rollback criteria & runbook: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/v2.19-rollout. Oncall: ops-oncall (PD_Rollout). Public announce: pending legal (now approved)."

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll watch the promote and call rollback if thresholds exceed.

zoe: Posting internal announce now and queueing public announce for 09:30 UTC. Thanks all :rocket:

deploybot: /announce internal "v2.19.0 staged rollout \u2014 canary healthy, promoting to staged" --channel=#eng-releases --when=7000000200

zoe: bot queued. Closing thread after promote.
